<div class="card-body">
'''TIE Vanguard''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイ・ヴァンガード</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。同じ星系で敵が戦闘を宣言した際、“リアクション”としてその星系にカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常どおりに支払う。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-TIE-Vanguard-PSA-90960106.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">偵察用戦闘機。しばしば作戦の最初に投入され、全艦隊が戦闘状態に入る前に、敵艦隊の動向に関する詳細な情報を集める。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' TIE Vanguard.

'''Card text:'''
A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. When the opponent initiates a battle at the same system, you may deploy cards to that system as a reaction. Pay the deploy cost as usual.

'''Lore:'''
A reconnaissance starfighter. It is often sent in first to gather detailed information on enemy fleet movement before the whole fleet enters combat.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 宇宙戦闘機：ＴＩＥ／ＲＣ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[TIE Vanguard]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
